result.summary: The page is largely well-designed with consistent spacing, typography, and branding. One notable visual defect: the bottom navigation bar highlights 'Profile' as the active tab (green) while the visible content is the Home feed, creating a navigation state mismatch. Horizontal carousel clipping and bottom viewport cutoff are treated as intended features and not reported.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar shows 'Profile' as the active/selected tab (green icon and label), yet the screen content displayed is the Home feed (delivery address, search, category chips, restaurant carousels). The active tab indicator does not match the visible screen, which is confusing and suggests a broken navigation state.
issues.suggestion: Sync the active tab indicator with the currently displayed screen. When the Home feed is shown, highlight the 'Home' tab (green) and render 'Profile' in the inactive gray state; ensure tab selection updates on navigation.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red unread-indicator dot with no accompanying badge count or text alternative, so the meaning of the dot may not be perceivable to screen-reader or low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label such as 'Notifications, unread' to the bell button, and consider a numeric badge or a larger, higher-contrast indicator for the unread state.
